findings.description: Directly inspected current crouch and sit renders: exposed gray thigh/body surfaces break through the shorts at the inner thighs; the sit pose leaves skin visible to the hip crease. Current garment coverage and pose fit are rejected.
Directly inspected current back, crouch, and sit renders: rear overskirt forms an angular raised block and narrow pointed cloth tails under the seat. Silhouette and pose deformation remain rejected.

Directly inspected current front, side, arms-up, and arm-cross renders: repeated triangular faceting/shading remains across the sleeves, shoulders, side torso, and waist. Image evidence cannot isolate mesh versus normals.

nextAction: Keep V12 rejected and release blocked. Next revision must structurally close shorts hip-flexion and inner-thigh coverage, replace unsupported rear tail geometry with a stable supported back hem, and smooth jacket panels. No improvement over V11 is claimed without a matched visual comparison. UV remains NOT_CREATED; fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package and release remain UNVERIFIED.
